nodes.title: Market Demand Research
nodes.node_goal: Establish the current demand for invoicing tools among freelance designers in India.
nodes.generated_prompt: Conduct research to determine the current demand for invoicing tools specifically among freelance designers in India. Use available data and public snippets to assess how many freelance designers are currently using invoicing tools and their satisfaction levels. Analyze trends and statistics that indicate the need for such tools in this market.

pass_condition.semantic_check: Is there evidence of a significant number of freelance designers in India seeking invoicing solutions?
